message: Budget is unlimited. The client wants to build a plugin/integration for Antigravity IDE, replacing the previous idea of a VS Code plugin. It requires direct API communication and file reading/writing.

[HIGH] OWASP A06: Node.js 20 LTS reached End-of-Life on April 30, 2026. Proposing an EOL runtime is a security risk. Please update the architecture to use an actively supported LTS version (e.g., Node.js 22 or 24).
